# sonarqube_email_configuration (Resource)

The SMTP server SonarQube sends notifications through (*Administration > Configuration > Email notifications*). The server holds one such configuration; creating this resource fails if one exists already: import it instead. SonarQube does not return secrets, so a secret changed outside Terraform is only noticed when it is removed. Uses the internal API `api/v2/system/email-configurations` (SonarQube Server 10.7 and Community Build 24.12 and later). Import ID: `email-configuration`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "smtp_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

resource "sonarqube_email_configuration" "this" {
  host              = "smtp.example.com"
  port              = 587
  security_protocol = "STARTTLS"
  from_address      = "sonarqube@example.com"
  subject_prefix    = "[SonarQube]"
  username          = "sonarqube"

  # Never stored in state. Bump the version to send a new password.
  basic_password_wo      = var.smtp_password
  credentials_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `from_address` (String) Address emails come from.
- `host` (String) SMTP server host.
- `port` (Number) SMTP server port, usually 25, 465 or 587.
- `security_protocol` (String) `NONE`, `SSLTLS` or `STARTTLS`.
- `username` (String) Username to authenticate to the SMTP server.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `auth_method` (String) `BASIC` (username and password) or `OAUTH` (Microsoft Exchange only). Defaults to `BASIC`.
- `basic_password` (String, Sensitive) Password for `BASIC` authentication. Stored in state; prefer `basic_password_wo`.
- `basic_password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Password for `BASIC` authentication. Write-only, never stored in state (Terraform 1.11+). Change `credentials_wo_version` to send a new value.
- `credentials_wo_version` (String) Any value; changing it sends the current `*_wo` credentials.
- `from_name` (String) Name emails come from. Defaults to `SonarQube`.
- `oauth_authentication_host` (String) For `OAUTH`: host of the identity provider issuing access tokens.
- `oauth_client_id` (String, Sensitive) Client ID for `OAUTH` authentication. Stored in state; prefer `oauth_client_id_wo`.
- `oauth_client_id_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Client ID for `OAUTH` authentication. Write-only, never stored in state (Terraform 1.11+). Change `credentials_wo_version` to send a new value.
- `oauth_client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret for `OAUTH` authentication. Stored in state; prefer `oauth_client_secret_wo`.
- `oauth_client_secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Client secret for `OAUTH` authentication. Write-only, never stored in state (Terraform 1.11+). Change `credentials_wo_version` to send a new value.
- `oauth_scope` (String) For `OAUTH`: scope of the token request. The server defaults it to `https://outlook.office365.com/.default`.
- `oauth_tenant` (String) For `OAUTH`: Microsoft tenant.
- `subject_prefix` (String) Prefix of email subjects. Defaults to `[SONARQUBE]`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `email-configuration`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sonarqube_email_configuration.this email-configuration
```
